about: Body plan (tools/body_plan.py explains every part). "bones" is the rename table: role name (left, used everywhere else in this file and in the tools) to the bone name in the model (right). The names are the placeholder models' for now; when the real model has other bone names, change only the right-hand side, then run python tools/body_plan.py check. A draft (tools/mod_paths.py, "Drafts"): the Matabele ant is not in the game yet. Its waist is a ponerine's: the one node (petiole), the joint to the gaster (gaster_front) and the pinch inside the gaster (gaster_back), the bend shared as the harvester ant's waist (my picks, to confirm).

hand_set.why: The gaster begins right behind the one waist node (gaster_front, 1.61 units back), not at its pinch (gaster_back, 3.99, where the measuring rule puts it as the gaster is two bones): judged from there, the gaster follows the ground over an edge without cutting the corner (0.04 blocks for the major, as the approved harvester worker; 0.12 measured). My pick, to confirm in the pose viewer's climbing course (tools/matabele_climb.py, gaster versions A, B, C).
